name: B10-0084/2026 (Renew) – Conviction and imminent sentencing of Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the conviction and imminent sentencing of Jimmy Lai in Hong Kong
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the conviction of Jimmy Lai, a British citizen and pro-democracy activist, by a Hong Kong court on national security charges in December 2025. It calls for his immediate release, along with other people held for using their freedoms. It also asks Hong Kong and China to repeal their national security laws and urges European Union countries to consider sanctions on officials responsible. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament demands Jimmy Lai's release and the dropping of all charges against him.
- It asks the Council to consider sanctions on Hong Kong and Chinese officials.
- It urges Member States to suspend extradition treaties with China and Hong Kong.
